label: SSC Photo
description: Standard photo format for SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS, CPO and GD Constable online applications. Requires 3.5 cm width by 4.5 cm height, file size between 20 KB and 50 KB in JPG/JPEG format.

label: SSC Signature
description: Scanned signature specification for all SSC recruitment exams. Requires 4.0 cm width by 2.0 cm height, strictly between 10 KB and 20 KB in JPG/JPEG format on white paper.

label: IBPS Photo & Signature
description: Standard photograph specification for IBPS PO, Clerk, SO, and RRB banking exams. Dimensions of 200 x 230 pixels, file size strictly between 20 KB and 50 KB.

label: IBPS Signature
description: Scanned signature on white paper with black ink for IBPS exam applications. Dimensions of 140 x 60 pixels, file size between 10 KB and 20 KB.

label: UPSC Civil Services Photo
description: UPSC Civil Services (IAS/IPS), NDA, CDS, and CAPF photograph. Minimum 350 x 350 pixels, file size between 20 KB and 300 KB, with clear white background.

label: UPSC Signature
description: UPSC online application scanned signature. Square dimension (350 x 350 px), file size between 20 KB and 300 KB.

label: RRB Railway Photo
description: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP) photo upload. Dimensions of 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm (or 35 x 45 mm), file size strictly between 20 KB and 50 KB.

label: PAN Card Photo
description: NSDL / UTIITSL PAN card application photo upload. Dimensions of 2.5 cm x 3.5 cm (213 x 213 px at 200 DPI), file size under 50 KB in JPEG format.
